releases.title: Media Logger 3 - 3.0
releases.body:
This is the biggest update since 2.0's big remake of the app. Not as big of course but tons of work done to improve the app into the best state I can get it (right now). Tons of work here.

Major Changes with 3.0:
- Major changes to Year View rendering: Caching added, progressive loading added, deferred grid rendering and many more changes. Less stutters and way better performance on big libraries.
- You can now choose to turn Adult Media types on or off, turning them off hides the options entirely from the application.
- By default all database files are now called media_logger.db, old databases automatically convert to new name and without loss of data.
- The 'Monthly Activity' and 'Score Trend' stat widgets in Stats now have a 'Compare' button allowing you to directly visually compare those two stats against another year (of your choosing). Making it much easier to compare stats instead of having to flip back and forth between years. Lots of changes in stats rendering to make this happen.
- All System-Font & SF Pro usage is now replaced with Inter to make MacOS & Windows versions look closer in visuals.
- Dashboard UI full redesign. Featured Entry takes up more space, stats are below the featured entry letting the featured entries image take up the space. Quick Action buttons removed. Recent Completions & On This Day now both sport a visual card UI design below. Also upgraded with new animations. Animated Stat Counters, Featured Card now has small animated image effect and Greeting Text is now word by word fade in.

New Content/Features:
- Tauri upgraded from 2.10.1 to 2.11.2
- On sidebar the years in your library now have little dots linking them together, like a little timeline.
- Settings & Library sections on sidebar can now be collapsed.
- Media Logger title and icon on top left removed entirely as redundant.
- Settings now has an About section showcasing the version and other important information.
- Settings now has a in-app change log so it's easy to see changes from the very beginning to now without need to access the development repo.
- Light Mode removed as not used & also did not function.
- Indicator for which page you are on is now animated and slides up/down to the next page you click on.
- Sidebar Years Timeline now animated. The ball animates between the different years you click on.
- Added Framer Motion dependency to project to enable more complex animation work.
- Nav Item hover is now animated with spring physics and glow trail.
- Year Timeline Dot now has a trailing blur / light streak on swap.
- Collapsible sections now are animated.
- When hovering over a card in the year view, the card now does a vertical lift and has a shadow that is coloured based on your theme.
- Media Shelf visuals and rendering removed as no longer used.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue in backups where exports silently drops Early Access fields
- Fixed an issue in which re-importing a backup duplicates every entry that has no completion date
- Fixed a bug which makes the open/close toggle and outside-click dismissal unreliable.
- Fixed an issue where a rating of `0` is treated as "no score" in JS-side averages
- Removed a ensureTablesExist function to use correct db script file function. 
- Removed dbService.getStats() as no longer used.
- Import are now fixed to use one transaction instead of many. Improving some performance in some areas.
- CSV exports/imports no longer coerces numeric-looking text into numbers
- Double-register menu listeners issue fixed for better feeling UI.
- 50ms delays to database actions removed as app now awaits for DB functions to finish so no extra waiting time needed.
- Collapsible sidebar sections clipping fixed.
- Image blob URL cache is now revoked when swapping pages, stopping a possible memory leak.
- Minor duplicates throughout the app removed to remove stale & old code that can be done in one function and not across 5 duplicates.

releases.title: Media Logger 2.10

- Description updated with a specific 'Notes' catagory so you can have a general description about what the entry is and specific notes about your personal thoughts about the entry.
- Autocomplete added, now auto suggests previous entries data such as previously used genres, authors, artists, actresses etc.
- When Exporting can now choose a zip file, including your json export alongside the folder with all images you have used in the app for use elsewhere or to reimport into the app another time.

- Collections now allow you to add multiple items at once. Previously was one at a time, now upgraded to a multi select picker.
- When making an 'award year' it now creates the year and saves it even without any award catagories added. Before it only created the 'year' if there was catagories.

Bug Fixes:

- Missing cover art now falls back to a bundled local asset instead of a remote placeholder. The new asset lives at cover-fallback.svg.

Performance Optimizations:

- Search is now DB-backed instead of loading the whole library into memory.

On older MacOS versions uses same transparency effects with no change. This applies to the side bar and drop down menu on an entry (when clicking three dots). 
- Background Setting Added - Can now choose to have Default, standard dark/light background or brand new 'Clear' which uses either Liquid Glass or Transparency to make the background 'clear'. (This actually is surprisingly really beautiful surprised me quite a bit)

releases.title: Media Logger 2.9
releases.body:
This is a update fully focused on cleanup. Added so much and big changes over recent updates, so focused on bug fixing and QOL for this one.

New Features:
- Dynamic years with Settings management (no hard-coded year lists in nav/stats anymore), with backward compatibility fallback for existing users.

Quality of Life:
- Dashboard's featured entry is now truly 100% random no weighting or anything now.
- Dashboard 2025 links removed; quick links now resolve dynamically from available/recent years.
- Light-mode QoL improved by removing key hard-coded dark assumptions in layout, honouring system mode fallback, and adding light-mode compatibility overrides for common dark-biased utility classes.
- Backup/import now includes profiles mappings so personalisation is portable.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed schema/query key mismatch for collections and awards by standardising on media_id in base schema and adding compatibility migrations that rebuild legacy tables using entry_id/added_date/old winner shapes into the new format.
- Added missing created_date support for award_categories in both fresh schema and migration path (including backfill for existing rows).
- Added creation of the profiles table for clean installs, so profile reads/writes no longer fail on new DBs.
- Rewrote CSV import parsing to handle quoted multiline fields correctly by tokenising full CSV rows with quote-state tracking instead of splitting on newline first.
- Added missing modal style classes used by the Settings import result modal (modal-overlay, modal-content) so styling/behaviour is now defined and stable.

Performance Improvements:
- Replaced expensive ORDER BY RANDOM() featured-entry query with a two-step random offset strategy
- Removed N+1 in collections & awards. Thumbnail candidates now loaded in one query and grouped in memory (first 4 per collection).

releases.title: Media Logger 2.8

- On the data tab on settings, now has a 'open directory' to easily access your data file path on your local machine
- Awards & Profiles now have a animation upon opening the page showing the buttons pop into the page. 
- Stats UI has a console error cleared with a small bug fix
- Top Genres on Stats page has been fully redesigned.  Now shows more on default view, has a pop up window to see all genres, can click a genre to see specific entries with that genre attached to it and even more.
- Rating Distribution is now taller and uses it's full card size instead of a fixed size
- New Custom Tooltips added to Rating Distribution & Top Genres, new details and UI to match the current UI design as it previously was basic tooltips.
- On the year view can now click a conditional field to take you directly to it's profile, and can click back to take you back to exactly where you were. This applies to all conditional fields like Author, Platform, Director etc
- Collections UI has been changed to adapt to your chosen theme colouring instead of generic gradient
- Collections can now have their titles and descriptions edited and changed.
- Collections now have a more faster and nicer animation, previously looked a little janky and like it was struggling to load, much faster and subdued now.

releases.title: Media Logger 2.1
releases.body:
Focus on bug fixes and improvements with some new features too. 

- Improved the layout of cards in Year View to better utilize available space, reducing wasted empty areas and allowing content to breathe more naturally.

- Overhauled the Stats section to be more detailed and visually engaging. Simple lists (Top Authors, Studios, etc.) have been replaced with charts and visual representations.

- Added a dedicated Actresses stats section, including a visual chart.

- Stats are now organized into dropdown sections to provide deeper insights without cluttering the interface.

- Fixed an issue where long descriptions could be cut off in Year View. Descriptions now properly support larger amounts of text, ensuring all information remains accessible.

- Added a “View Image” option to the Year View entry dropdown, allowing full-size images to be viewed for any entry.

- Genre overflow indicators (e.g. “+2”) now display the remaining genres in a hover popup, making all genres easily visible.

- Fixed an issue where multiple actresses were displayed as a single combined tag; actresses now appear as separate, individual tags.

- Fixed an issue where the selected stats filter did not persist; filter selections now remain saved after reloads or reboots.

- Improved readability of stats tooltips by fixing text contrast issues (previously black text on dark backgrounds).

- Fixed the Add Entry button in the left panel, which previously did not function. Both add entry buttons now work as expected.

- Hovering over the Rewatch and Local Copy icons now displays tooltips explaining their meaning, improving clarity for new users.

- Fixed an issue in Collections & Search where selecting Edit from an entry’s dropdown menu had no effect.

releases.title: Media Logger 2.0 / V20
releases.body:
This is an entire project remake from Python & Flet into Tauri + React + TypeScript. Completely rebuilt from the ground up with a new UI design, new features and backward compatibility. The same assets/images & .db file will work on both Python & Tauri versions.

Going forward it will be Media Logger 2.0 > 2.1 and so on. The Python era has ended, though is preserved through a legacy branch on the repo, swap to it and any time with all updates up to V19 (and a small 2026 update I did not turn into it's own release)

- Entirely rebuilt from the ground up in Tauri
- Same year view, stats, profiles, search, collections, awards are all functioning
- Everything works almost entirely the same as it did in the Flet/Python version.

- For new additions:
- Customisable data path, can store your .db/Images folder anywhere now
- Completely new UI design language
- A icon for the app no longer using default Flet/Tauri
- Now a standalone app file provided no longer needing to just run the raw 'main.py' just run the app
- Uses less RAM about 10-20% on average
- Image loading is faster and more system resource efficient. 
- And so much more stuff behind the scenes changed, it's a more modern, better designed and modular app compared to the Python version. Taken a ton of work but it's here.
